node.title: Re^2: How can I match this }\n} in perl
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
whitespace you're not accounting for ... If that's the case, I think you would want /} \w*}/

That should probably be /} \s*}/, since \w means a word character.

/} ?}/

That should probably be /} ? }/, since would be LFCR ([doc://perlport#Newlines|see also]).
